metadata.title: Lehmer's number is not an orientable stretch factor in genus six
metadata.abstract: Let $\lambda_L \approx 1.17628$ be Lehmer's number. We prove that no pseudo-Anosov homeomorphism of a closed orientable surface of genus six with orientable invariant foliations has stretch factor $\lambda_L$. This gives a negative answer to a question of Lanneau and Thiffeault on the minimal stretch factor in even genus. As a consequence, the minimal stretch factor $\delta_6^{+}$ of such maps is the largest root of $x^{12}-x^{9}-x^{7}+x^{6}-x^{5}-x^{3}+1$, approximately $1.20189$. The proof combines the Lefschetz method of Lanneau and Thiffeault, the standardly embedded train tracks of Hironaka and Tsang, an elementary analysis of the transition digraph, and an obstruction from periodic conjugacy classes in the fundamental group.

analysis.workSummary: 证明闭可定向亏格六曲面上、具有可定向不变叶状结构的伪Anosov同胚，不可能以Lehmer数约1.17628为伸缩因子，否定Lanneau–Thiffeault关于偶亏格最小伸缩因子的一个问题。相应最小值δ₆⁺是x¹²−x⁹−x⁷+x⁶−x⁵−x³+1的最大实根，约1.20189。

analysis.breakthrough: 排除一个低熵候选并确定所述亏格六可定向叶状结构类的最小伸缩因子。
analysis.limitations: 亏格六、闭曲面和不变叶状结构可定向均须保留；不是所有伪Anosov映射或所有偶亏格的统一最小值结论。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
